company.name: Dirac
company.shortDescription: Dirac is an assembly automation software that develops an automated work instruction platform to improve mechanical design.
company.description: Dirac is an assembly automation software that develops an automated work instruction platform to improve mechanical design. The company aims to advance American industry through innovative solutions that streamline and enhance the production process. Its flagship product, BuildOS, automatically generates precise assembly work instructions directly from CAD files, allowing companies to transition from design to production. Dirac is committed to strengthening America's manufacturing sector by providing tools that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure the highest levels of productivity.
